questions.question: Aaron's sons Nadab and Abihu died before their father and left sons behind to serve as priests. True or false?
When King David organized the descendants of Aaron to serve as priests, how did he divide them into groups?

answers.text: By the roles they served in
By the towns they lived in
By the years they were born

questions.question: How did the priestly families of Eleazar and Ithamar decide their order for serving in the house of the LORD?

answers.text: By letting the oldest go first

questions.question: The twenty-four priestly families served in the house of the LORD by regulations set by which forefather?
